statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail stays below the block threshold because NQ futures held roughly 200 points above their session low even as the cash index settled at its low, while Stress remains high on conflicting cross-asset signals and a large post-close memory-sector result.
recommendation: Tail is in the watch band and below the block threshold. The flagged window spans the 20:00Z cash close through 23:00Z, covering the post-close memory-sector fiscal Q4 result and its conference call in thinning liquidity.
headline: Nasdaq-100 fades into a quarter-end close at the session low, with a large post-close memory result the immediate checkpoint
body: The Nasdaq-100 closed the final session of the third quarter at 30,408.50, up 69.17 points or 0.23%, after opening at 30,421.68 against a 30,339.33 previous close and reaching 30,630.45 intraday. The cash index settled at its own session low, giving back roughly 222 points from the high into the quarter-end closing auction. NQ futures, the preferred continuous reference, tell a less directional story: at 30,712.50 (+0.32%) they sit about 193 points below the 30,905.50 session high but still roughly 200 points above the 30,512.25 session low, inside the day's range rather than extending through it. That mid-range position, together with VIX at 16.42 below its 16.61 session high, indicates a completed fade rather than a persistent no-retracement path, so Tail stays in the watch band at 22. Leadership was unusually narrow. The Dow fell 0.86% or 443.87 points to 50,906.05 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,651.54, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.24% to 26,861.06. For the quarter the S&P 500 added about 2% and the Nasdaq about 2.5% against a 2.7% Dow decline; for September the Dow lost 4.9% and the S&P 500 0.7% while the Nasdaq rose 1.7%. Stress stays high at 72 because cross-asset signals conflict with the equity advance. August PCE printed softer than expected at 3.4% year over year against 3.7% anticipated, with core at 3.0%, and implied October hike odds fell to roughly 37% from above 70% a week earlier, yet the 10-year yield still rose about four basis points to 5.298% after trading above 5.30%, and the 30-year added nearly five basis points to 5.642%. Energy also firmed, with WTI up 1.25% to about $90.50 and Brent up 1.94% to about $98.02 on continued uncertainty around US-Iran negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz. The dominant new catalyst arrived after the close: Micron reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $54.23 billion against its own guidance near $50 billion, non-GAAP earnings of $33.42 per share and an 87.0% non-GAAP gross margin, then guided fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue to $61.5 billion and non-GAAP earnings to $38.15 per share, both well above prior expectations. A result of that size creates a credible unresolved second information wave for semiconductors and the index during thin post-settlement hours, which is why the danger window covers the release and its conference call through 23:00Z and why forecast Tail is nudged to 23 for the call hour. Consistent with the contract, event magnitude alone is scored into Stress and Confidence rather than into Tail: the pathological path is not assumed before it is observed. Confidence is 88 on verified current index, futures, volatility, yield and energy levels, the primary Micron filing and a verified seven-day US calendar. The shared Finviz context file was read but carried a 2026-09-29T23:14Z collection time, roughly 21 hours old and beyond the 90-minute freshness limit, with partial coverage and no futures section, so it was treated as stale and not used as evidence. The next scheduled checkpoints are initial jobless claims and ISM Manufacturing on 1 October, followed by the September payrolls report on 2 October.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the published Claude state moved from the watch band into the low band overnight, with Tail easing to 15-16 through the Asian and European sessions, then rebuilt from 12:35Z as the US session brought the August PCE release, rising yields and quarter-end positioning. Tail peaked at 23 in the 15:00Z and 16:00Z hours and settled back to 21 by 19:00Z. Stress stayed high throughout, in a 65-75 band, and Confidence held between 85 and 88.
outlookSummary: The immediate focus is the post-close memory-sector result and its conference call through 23:00Z, where thin liquidity and a large guidance revision could extend semiconductor repricing into the index. Conditional Tail is held at 22-23 for that window, then eases into the low band across the Asian and European sessions on the assumption that the repricing finds a level and retracements occur. Risk rebuilds into the 1 October US data block, with initial jobless claims at 12:30Z and ISM Manufacturing at 14:00Z overlapping the cash open, where conditional Tail returns to 22-23. None of the post-cutoff price structure is observed; each later hour describes a checkpoint or invalidation rather than an established path.
